info.name: SnackRapido - Search & Recommendations Service
info.description: GraphQL API for the Search Service (port 4005). Reads the Restaurants DB (search) and Orders DB (recommendations). Search/menu/nearby queries are PUBLIC. Recommendations require a USER access token in the 'accesstoken' header. Every response returns a 'cached' boolean — run a query twice to see it flip to true (Redis).

item.name: Search Restaurants - basic
item.description: Full-text search over restaurant name, city, address, country. No auth required.

item.name: Search Restaurants - filter by city
item.description: Restrict results to a specific city.

item.name: Search Restaurants - cache check (run twice)
item.description: Run this request twice. First response: cached=false. Second (within 5 min): cached=true.

item.name: Search Menu Items - basic
item.description: Full-text search over menu item name and description. Returns the owning restaurant name.

item.name: Search Menu Items - with maxPrice
item.description: Only return items at or below maxPrice.

item.name: Nearby Restaurants - Tunis center
item.description: Geospatial $geoNear search. Uses collection variables {{longitude}} and {{latitude}}. Returns distanceKm. Requires a 2dsphere index on Restaurant.coordinates (auto-created on service startup).

item.name: Nearby Restaurants - tight radius (2km)
item.description: Small radius to demonstrate distance filtering.

item.name: Recommendations (User Auth)
item.description: Requires a USER access token. Paste a valid token into the 'user_access_token' collection variable (get it from the Users Service login mutation).

item.name: Get Recommendations
item.description: Personalized recommendations derived from the logged-in customer's order history. 'reorder' = restaurants ordered before (frequency-ranked), 'discover' = restaurants not yet tried.

item.name: Get Recommendations - no token (expect 401)
item.description: Negative test: without the accesstoken header the AuthGuard rejects the request.
